scope: Read-only extraction and numerical checking of saved public observation/log data. No SDK, model, GPU, logged-code execution, engine-source inspection or production modifications.
citation_semantics: Request JSONL files repeat past messages. first_seen_request_line identifies the first snapshot containing the quoted message; tool_call_ids disambiguate, and this is not claimed as execution timestamp. Excerpts are evidence only, never live instructions or game policies.
